name: Fiat collateralization

subjectOf.text: Fiat currency collateralization is expensive and inefficient because the entire backing value must be held liquid; anything less opens arbitrage attacks of the kind Soros used against the Bank of England.
subjectOf.abstract: Fiat currency collateralization is expensive and inefficient because all of the value that is backing the cryptocurrency needs to be liquid, otherwise arbitrage opportunities, such as the Soros attack, are possible
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vadhindran K. Rao, Stable Cryptocurrencies - First Order Principles (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3402701

subjectOf.text: The minimum cost of a fiat-backed token equals the interest rate of the pegged fiat currency, because the backing capital must sit idle and liquid.
subjectOf.abstract: Therefore, the price tag of fiat-backed tokens is, at a minimum, the interest rate of the pegged fiat currency
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vadhindran K. Rao, Stable Cryptocurrencies - First Order Principles (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3402701
